decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design and Access Statement, Materials Schedule, 000, 010, 011, 040, 041, 060, and 110 received: 20/11/2017. 042 Rev 01, 043 Rev 01, 061 Rev 01, 141 Rev 01, 160 Rev 01, and 061 Rev 01 received: 06/12/2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey infill extension and refurbishment to existing office premises, including internal alterations, replacement of fenestration and replacement rear staircase to first floor level.
